correctness.rationale: The exact survival function gives f_b(t)=log((b+1)/b)-log(1-t)-(b+2)t^2/2 for t in [0,1). For b<=2 derivative is nonnegative; for b>2 only interior local minimum is at t_+=(1+sqrt((b-2)/(b+2)))/2, with positive endpoint f(0) and divergence at t->1. Envelope differentiation gives H'(b)=-1/[b(b+1)]-t_+^2/2<0; H(2+)=log 3-1/2>0 and H->-infinity. Thus exactly one threshold and explicit failure above. Supports eps>=0 including endpoint outside compact support; one-sided only. Independently solved H=0 at b=3.7534772184455018261094865454351.
